page.overview:
Who is Robot?

Rex Connors, formerly known as Rudolph "Rudy" Connors, is a major character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

He is an exceptionally intelligent human scientist who was born with significant physical deformities and health problems. To overcome his physical limitations and pursue his ambitions, he developed a combat-ready robotic body, allowing him to operate as the superhero known as Robot. He was eventually recruited as the leader of the Teen Team before becoming a member of the new Guardians of the Globe following the original team’s murder at the hands of Omni-Man. After falling in love with Monster Girl, Robot hired the Mauler Twins to transfer his mind into a clone body created from a sample of Rex Splode's blood. Although the clone went on to begin a new life, the original Robot eventually died peacefully.

With Amanda’s support, Robot began learning how to lead a more ordinary life while continuing to protect Earth and its inhabitants from various threats. Following Rex Splode’s heroic sacrifice during the Invincible War, Robot adopted Rex’s first name as a tribute to his fallen friend. Not long afterward, the Flaxans returned to Earth, and with the help of Robot and Monster Girl, their latest invasion was stopped. However, the two were left stranded in the Flaxan Dimension for an unclear duration.

Originally, Robot was a severely deformed human, barely larger than a child and crumpled inside a liquid-filled pod with mechanical legs. His skin was pale and covered in sores and blisters, his nose hidden (or replaced) by a mechanical clamp, and his only working eye was the yellow-green right eye.

Also known as: Robot Guardian, Rudy Connors.
